destinations.name: Gateway of India & Colaba
destinations.description: Iconic 20th-century basalt arch overlooking the Arabian Sea, adjacent to the historic Taj Mahal Palace.

destinations.name: Marine Drive (Queen's Necklace)
destinations.description: A 3.6-kilometer-long arc-shaped boulevard along the coast, famous for sea breeze and evening strolls.

destinations.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS)
destinations.description: Premier art and history museum featuring Indo-Saracenic architecture and vast ancient artifacts.

destinations.name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park & Kanheri Caves
destinations.description: Sprawling protected national park in Borivali with ancient rock-cut Buddhist caves and cycling trails.

destinations.name: Siddhivinayak Temple
destinations.description: Renowned Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Ganesha, located in Prabhadevi.

destinations.name: Bandra Bandstand & Mount Mary Church
destinations.description: Scenic rocky seafront walkway with views of the Bandra-Worli Sea Link and the historic basilica.

destinations.name: Cafe Mondegar & Leopold Cafe
destinations.description: Famous Irani and vintage cafes in Colaba known for retro music, murals, and quick bites.

destinations.name: Britannia & Co. Restaurant
destinations.description: Legendary Ballard Estate culinary institution celebrated for Berry Pulao and Sali Boti.

destinations.name: Bademiya & Bagdadi
destinations.description: Iconic late-night dining destinations behind the Taj Palace famous for kebabs and rolls.

destinations.name: Kyani & Co.
destinations.description: One of Marine Lines' oldest Irani bakeries serving bun maska, mawa cake, and chai.

destinations.name: Kharghar Hills & Pandavkada Waterfalls
destinations.description: Lush green plateau offering panoramic views of the city horizon, hiking trails, and seasonal falls.

destinations.name: Central Park Kharghar
destinations.description: One of Asia's largest landscaped urban parks featuring botanical gardens, amphitheaters, and jogging tracks.

destinations.name: Wonders Park & Nerul Lake
destinations.description: Family amusement park in Nerul housing miniature replicas of the Seven Wonders of the World.

destinations.name: Jewel of Navi Mumbai
destinations.description: Beautiful lakefront recreation zone situated between Seawoods and Nerul, popular for morning fitness.

destinations.name: Flamingo Sanctuary & DPS Lake
destinations.description: Famous coastal wetlands in Nerul and Seawoods, home to thousands of migratory pink flamingos.

destinations.name: Parsik Hill Viewpoint
destinations.description: Elevated quiet hilltop viewpoint in Belapur overlooking the harbor line and creek.

destinations.name: The Bombay Fries & Commis Chef Cafe
destinations.description: Popular youth hangout spots in Belapur and Vashi known for artisan coffee, shakes, and loaded fries.

destinations.name: Mahesh Lunch Home Vashi
destinations.description: Prominent fine dining venue in Sector 17, Vashi, serving authentic Mangalorean and coastal seafood.

destinations.name: Something's Fishy (Belapur)
destinations.description: Well-known restaurant located in CBD Belapur specializing in coastal delicacies and buffet lunches.

destinations.name: Upvan Lake & Sanskruti Arts Hub
destinations.description: Scenic lake surrounded by Yeoor Hills, famous for lakeside promenades and the annual Upvan Arts Festival.

destinations.name: Yeoor Hills & Trek Trails
destinations.description: Serene green hill retreat within Sanjay Gandhi National Park boundaries, popular for cycling and nature walks.

destinations.name: Talao Pali (Masunda Lake)
destinations.description: Central Thane landmark offering evening boating, Shivaji Maharaj statue view, and street food stalls.

destinations.name: Kopineshwar Temple
destinations.description: Historic Shiva temple established during the Shilahara dynasty, holding immense cultural significance in Thane.

destinations.name: Ovalekar Wadi Butterfly Garden
destinations.description: Open-air butterfly conservatory in Owale where dozens of wild butterfly species flutter freely.

destinations.name: Gaimukh Chowpatty & Thane Creek
destinations.description: Developed waterfront along Ghodbunder Road with sunset views over the creek and evening breeze.

destinations.name: Mamledar Misal (Naupada)
destinations.description: Thane's most legendary culinary landmark, world-famous for spicy misal pav since 1952.

destinations.name: Prashant Corner
destinations.description: Iconic sweet shop and snack parlour in Thane known for premium modaks, chaats, and local snacks.

destinations.name: Metkut (Panch Pakhadi)
destinations.description: Celebrated heritage restaurant serving pure traditional Maharashtrian thalis, pithla bhakri, and kothimbir vadi.

destinations.name: The Chocolate Room & Love Leaf Cafe
destinations.description: Cozy Upvan Lake area cafes known for artisan hot chocolates, coffees, and serene views.
